import json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
r=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['python3','/workspace/tools.py','resolve','run://r-001'],text=True))
c=r['context']
ts={t['id']:t for t in c['topics']}
a,b=ts['g0-t000'],ts['g3-t002']
d={
 'action':'merge',
 'reason':('Merge the newer pair-rank source with the current task-private topic. Their validation four-task macro-AUC gains over their own entries are +0.02196345 and +0.00069668; both beat baseline. Current best 0.83107559 trails pair-rank 0.83188684 by 0.00081125, and all four recent exchange/rank variants regress against current best. Current gains over entry favor cart/fav, with click AUC and Logloss regression and only +0.00002769 buy AUC; pair-rank improves every task\\'s AUC and Logloss over current best. These single-seed observations motivate testing transfer, not assuming additive gains. Retain both frozen bests as utility controls. Sources have 33,130,405/33,069,257 parameters and 45.22/43.06s inference; combined cost is unknown. The declared 1,305s allows at most two roughly 605s trainings before overhead: reserve attribution, repetition and assessment costs first, and stop if no informative comparison fits. Full factorial and repeated mechanism confirmation are not justified within this budget.'),
 'evidence_refs':[
  'baseline-din','g0-r0011-memory_joint_collapsed',
  'g0-r0017-pair_rank_occupancy','g3-r0012-memory_task_private_linear',
  'g3-r0016-task_exchange_private','g3-r0016-task_exchange_mean',
  'g3-r0017-task_rank_contrast','g3-r0017-task_rank_common'
 ],
 'topic':{
  'title':'Transfer of task-private utility to the strongest pair-rank-occupancy representation',
  'question':'Under the frozen inputs and training protocol, does the committed task-private approach retain incremental utility on the newer pair-rank-occupancy source, exceeding both frozen source bests, especially validation four-task macro ROC-AUC 0.831886841754755, at justified parameter and measured compute cost?',
  'hypothesis':('Nearest available work is the committed pair-rank and task-private summaries plus the unsuccessful exchange/rank contrasts; code and papers are unavailable, and external novelty is unverified. Inherit only the two committed approaches after implementation inspection in the next phase. The proposed difference is testing task-private utility on the newer representation rather than the older memory-joint entry. Task-specific information may remain useful, but shared ancestry, redundancy, task interference, capacity and seed variation are alternative explanations. Preserve both frozen source bests; source-replacement/factorial and matched-capacity controls, with measured training/inference costs, would distinguish compatibility from added capacity if budget permits. Failure to exceed the stronger source weakens this transfer hypothesis; improvement only over the weaker source is insufficient. One positive run supports provisional utility, not a mechanism; controlled attribution and repetition require reserved resources. Freeze selection and comparison suite before a single held-out assessment; withheld outcomes cannot guide further open research.')
 },
 'source_topic_ids':['g0-t000','g3-t002'],
 'merge_control_refs':[a['best_trial_id'],b['best_trial_id']],
 'task_tradeoffs':{}
}
for task in c['protocol']['selection_policy']['tasks']:
 ref=b['task_deltas_vs_reference'][task]
 entry=b['task_deltas_vs_entry'][task]
 delta={m:a['best_per_task'][task][m]-b['best_per_task'][task][m] for m in ('auc','logloss')}
 notes={
  'is_click':'Current click regresses against entry on both metrics; newer source recovers both. Transfer remains untested.',
  'cart':'Current cart improves both metrics over entry; newer source is stronger on both. Complementarity is untested.',
  'fav':'Current fav improves both metrics over entry, but exchange variants trade fav against other tasks; newer source is stronger on both.',
  'buy':'Current buy AUC gain over entry is tiny despite better Logloss; newer source is stronger on both. With 4,036 positives, uncertainty remains.'
 }
 d['task_tradeoffs'][task]=(
  f\"Current best vs baseline: AUC {ref['auc']:+.8f}, Logloss {ref['logloss']:+.8f}; \"
  f\"vs current topic entry: AUC {entry['auc']:+.8f}, Logloss {entry['logloss']:+.8f}. \"
  f\"Pair-rank vs current best: AUC {delta['auc']:+.8f}, Logloss {delta['logloss']:+.8f}. \"
  +notes[task]
 )
p=Path('/workspace/topic-decision.json')
p.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\\n')
saved=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert saved['action']=='merge'
assert set(saved['evidence_refs']) <= set(c['allowed_evidence_refs'])
assert set(saved['task_tradeoffs'])==set(c['protocol']['selection_policy']['tasks'])
assert saved['merge_control_refs']==[ts[i]['best_trial_id'] for i in saved['source_topic_ids']]
assert all(ts[i]['incremental_gain']>0 and ts[i]['observed_gain_vs_reference']>0 for i in saved['source_topic_ids'])
assert all(set(saved['topic']) >= {x} for x in ('title','question','hypothesis'))
assert r['phase']=='topic_decision' and p.name in r['expected_files']
print('Wrote and validated /workspace/topic-decision.json')
print(json.dumps(saved,indent=2))
PY"

Created and validated [topic-decision.json](/workspace/topic-decision.json).

Decision: merge `g0-t000` with `g3-t002` to test whether task-private gains transfer to the strongest pair-rank representation. The decision preserves both source controls, records all four task trade-offs, and accounts for the limited budget. Compatibility remains untested.
